title: Yahweh acknowledges the gods of Egypt in Exodus

tellings.quote: the Hebrew God, Yahweh, recognizes and acknowledges the existence of the gods of Egypt. in in Exodus, he tells Moses that he's going to execute his I think it's Exodus 12, he tells him that he's going to execute his wrath on the gods of Egypt.

plain: The Hebrew God, Yahweh, admits that the gods of Egypt exist, the researcher Luke Caverns tells Michels, pointing to Exodus 12, where God tells Moses he will bring his wrath on them. In the King James Bible of 1611 the verse reads "against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the LORD", so the text does speak of judging those gods. Whether it treats them as real beings or as idols and the people who worship them, the verse leaves open as a matter of reading.
